crossRefs.note: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
translations.bsb: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
translations.kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
translations.asv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Jehovah brought the fear of him upon all nations.
